apps.about: House Help Tracker keeps a simple record for the people who help run your home: your cook, maid, car cleaner, driver, or a stand-in who helps for a few days. Every day counts as present unless you mark it otherwise, and pay is worked out for you.

features.title: Attendance in one tap
points: Absent, half day, planned leave, weekly off or paid holiday
Plan leave ahead for festivals and trips home
A paid holiday for everyone at once

features.title: Pay worked out for you
points: Free leaves, bonus, advances in instalments
Pay by UPI with the amount filled in
Raises never change months already paid

features.title: Slips and reports on WhatsApp
points: Detailed pay slip as a message or picture
Monthly report of everyone's pay and dues
Leave messages in English, Hindi or Marathi

features.title: Expiry tracker for the home
points: Add a photo of each product
Scan or say the name and expiry date
Reminders 7 days before and on the day

features.title: Private by design
points: No sign-up, no account, no ads
All records stay on your phone
Backup and restore, light and dark mode

dataSafety.title: Your records stay on your phone
dataSafety.text: Names, numbers, pay, attendance and items are never sent to the developer or anyone else.

dataSafety.title: No ads, no tracking
dataSafety.text: The app has no ads and no analytics of its own.

dataSafety.title: Google diagnostics for scanning
dataSafety.text: Google ML Kit, used to read packs on the phone, may send Google basic diagnostics such as phone model and app performance. Photos are never sent.

notes: Extra work: note when your house help does more than usual, such as cooking for guests, a party or function, extra cleaning or extra hours. Pick the dates (for example 8 to 19 November), how many extra people, and how you pay: per extra person per day, per day, a fixed amount, or no extra pay (just a note).
The extra pay is worked out for you (for example 3 people × 12 days × ₹50 = ₹1,800) and added to that month's pay.
It shows on the person's page, as a green + on those days in the calendar, on the pay slip (message and picture) and in the monthly report.
Optionally send a thank-you message saying the amount is added to their pay, in English, Hindi or Marathi.

Common reasons in one tap: when you mark Absent, Half day or any leave, pick a reason instead of typing it: unwell, fever, child unwell, going to the village, wedding or function, festival, guests at home, doctor visit, heavy rain, no bus or auto, came late, left early and more. Reasons show in English, Hindi or Marathi.

When you ask them not to come: a second set of reasons for your side: we are going out, out of town, eating out tonight (don't come in the evening), lunch outside or not needed in the morning, not needed today, festival holiday and more. These are saved as paid leave or a paid half day, so no money is cut.

The right message: for your reasons, the WhatsApp/SMS message tells them not to come on that day (or that morning or evening) and that no money will be cut, in their language. For their reasons, the message includes the reason.
Tapping Absent or Half day on the Today card now opens these reasons first. Plan leave has the same reasons too.
Easier to tap: the month arrows, Pay, Give advance, Copy, category chips and other small buttons now have a bigger touch area.
Hindi and Marathi: "Weekly off" no longer shows the same word as Leave or Holiday in the calendar key and totals.
Small phones: the three totals on Home and Expiry stay in one neat row, the month name no longer wraps, and long names on the Payments page stay within two lines.
Safer records: a damaged advance entry from an old backup can no longer stop a person's page from opening.
Saved confirmation: when you mark absent, half day, any kind of leave, a weekly off or a holiday, a "Saved" pop-up with a tick shows what was saved, for whom, the date and the reason.
Back button on it: tap Back to return to Home, or Done to stay on the person's page.
Send message is now a button on the same pop-up, so the leave message opens only when you want it.
Paid leave: give your cook, maid or any house help a full day or half day of paid leave. Tap a day → More → Paid leave or Paid half day, and add the reason. No money is cut for it.
The reason shows in the month's leave log, and paid leave days are listed on the pay slip.

Free trial is now 45 days: every feature is free for 45 days from when you first used version 1.21 or later. After that, one house help with attendance and pay stays free, and Pro (₹49 a month or ₹399 a year) unlocks everything.
